_comment: Source -> docs coupling map for Politicas. When a turn edits source matching an entry's sourceGlobs with user- or contributor-visible effect (new/removed route, changed module architecture, new command, design-token or lint-rule change, sample-data-layer status), update the coupled doc in the SAME change. Internal-only edits (refactors, bugfixes with no behavior shift) need no doc update. A single source glob may couple to several docs.
